title: Run prompt
text: Trim and lock before asynchronous work.
explanation: Shared React state preserves prompt, mode, result and timeline across all five lesson tabs.

title: POST to the same-origin API
text: Send JSON to the browser-facing origin.
explanation: Vite proxies directly to Node locally. Kubernetes port-forward exposes the Service for local use; React contains no API key.

title: Select ready application Pods
text: The Service selects this edition’s Pods.
explanation: ClusterIP is private to the cluster. Readiness removes terminating or unready Pods from Service endpoints. Port-forward picks one Pod and does not demonstrate load balancing.

title: Deliver to the Node container
text: Run the application image with runtime configuration.
explanation: The same image contains compiled React, Node API and the native SDK CLI. Configuration comes from a ConfigMap; only the server receives the model key through secretKeyRef.

title: Start real SDK runtime
text: Execute the actual TypeScript Agent SDK.
explanation: Every run owns temporary work, home and configuration directories. Tools, MCP, plugins, settings, skills and persistence are disabled.

title: Exchange messages with Claude
explanation: The CLI owns the provider HTTPS exchange. This excerpt shows the application boundary rather than invented provider internals.

title: Project a safe SDK message
text: Select public lifecycle and text fields.
explanation: No raw thinking, paths, session IDs or tool inputs reach the browser. Model key occurrences are redacted. SDK messages are not guaranteed token deltas.

title: Flush the Node SSE response
text: Flush headers and pipe with backpressure.
explanation: Browser disconnect aborts the request and its owned SDK work. The transport never waits for a complete answer before sending events.

title: Keep the stream active
text: Write idle heartbeat comments every 15 seconds.
explanation: The Service forwards TCP traffic without application-level SSE buffering. Any added ingress must explicitly support streaming and a timeout longer than the 180-second agent deadline.

title: Normalize final result
text: Preserve the final answer and reported metrics.
explanation: A non-success subtype remains an error even if the raw flag disagrees. Missing cost stays null.

title: Validate final result event
text: Require a typed final result and done.
explanation: The parser handles fragmented UTF-8, CRLF and incomplete frames. A display cap never prevents final-result processing.

title: Render safe colored Markdown
text: Highlight code and sanitize generated HTML.
explanation: Highlight.js colors TypeScript, JSON, Docker and Kubernetes examples; DOMPurify removes active markup before rendering.

title: Complete result plus done
text: Complete transport after the final result.
explanation: Transport completion never changes a failed SDK result into a success.

title: Send safe stream failure
text: Send an error event without done.
explanation: Deadlines and disconnects cancel owned execution. A full Pod returns429 before starting another SDK process. No retry can replay an expensive request automatically.

title: Show recoverable error
text: Explain the failure and release controls.
explanation: Cancel aborts browser fetch. Finally clears the timer and lock. A rollout may interrupt a long-running request; retry is explicit.

title: Reject missing model key
explanation: Local Node reads backend/.env; Docker receives runtime environment and Kubernetes uses a Secret. Health checks never use model credits or claim provider authentication.
